'''Adriana Cristina Serquis''' (born 7 November 1967) is an Argentine physicist and researcher associated to the [[National Scientific and Technical Research Council]] (CONICET). From 2021 to 2024 she was president of the [[National Atomic Energy Commission]] (CNEA). In 2014, she received the [[L'Oréal-UNESCO For Women in Science Awards|L'Oréal-UNESCO National Award For Women in Science]] for her contribution to the rational use of electrical energy.

In [[2025 Argentine legislative election|2025]] she was elected to the [[Argentine Chamber of Deputies|National Chamber of Deputies]] to represent [[Río Negro Province|Río Negro]] on the [[Fuerza Patria]] list.

==Biography==
Adriana Cristina Serquis was born in [[Buenos Aires]] on 7 November 1967.<ref name=Konex>{{Cite web |url=https://www.fundacionkonex.org/b4592-adriana-c-serquis |title=Adriana C. Serquis |publisher=[[Konex Foundation]] |language=Spanish |access-date=2021-08-10}}</ref> She took an interest in physics at an early age.

{{Quote|My grandfather had not finished primary school, but he was a born researcher. He built a crystal radio, and was the one who fixed all the damaged appliances in the neighborhood where he lived, and where we visited him every summer, in Córdoba. My father was an industrial engineer. When I discovered physics, in the first year of the Sagrado Corazón, in Villa Celina, I knew immediately that that was what I wanted to study.<ref name=ganadora>{{Cite news |url=https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/adriana-serquis-ganadora-del-premio-loreal-unesco-nid1744547/ |title=Adriana Serquis, ganadora del premio L'Oréal-Unesco |trans-title=Adriana Serquis, Winner of the L'Oréal-UNESCO Award |first=Nora |last=Bär |newspaper=[[La Nación]] |language=Spanish |date=2014-11-17 |access-date=2021-08-10}}</ref>}}

She earned a [[Licentiate (degree)#Argentina|licentiate]] in physical sciences at the [[Faculty of Exact and Natural Sciences]] of the [[University of Buenos Aires]] in 1993, and a doctorate in physical sciences at the [[Balseiro Institute]] in 2000.<ref name=ganadora/><ref name=coloquio>{{Cite web |url=https://www.ib.edu.ar/comunicacion-y-prensa/noticias/item/1848-la-fisica-adriana-serquis-expondra-sobre-el-dia-de-la-mujer-en-el-primer-coloquio-del-balseiro-del-2021.html |title=La física Adriana Serquis expondrá sobre el Día de la Mujer en el primer coloquio del Balseiro del 2021 |trans-title=The Physicist Adriana Serquis Will Speak About Women's Day at the Balseiro's First Colloquium of 2021 |publisher=[[Balseiro Institute]] |language=Spanish |date=2021-03-10 |access-date=2021-08-10 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210526214754/https://www.ib.edu.ar/comunicacion-y-prensa/noticias/item/1848-la-fisica-adriana-serquis-expondra-sobre-el-dia-de-la-mujer-en-el-primer-coloquio-del-balseiro-del-2021.html |archive-date=26 May 2021 |url-status=dead}}</ref>

From 1994 to 2000, she was a fellow of the [[National Atomic Energy Commission|CNEA]] and CONICET. From 2001 to 2003, she was a post-doctoral researcher at [[Los Alamos National Laboratory]] in the United States.<ref name=Konex/>

As CONICET's principal researcher at the CNEA's [[Bariloche Atomic Centre|Bariloche Atomic Center]], her line of research was framed in developing advanced techniques for characterizing materials for [[Sustainable energy|clean energies]], where she studied the synthesis and characterization of superconducting materials and nanometric oxides for high temperature [[fuel cell]]s.<ref name=ganadora/><ref name=coloquio/>

She also served as an adjunct professor at the Andean Headquarters of the [[National University of Río Negro]], dictating materials for the chemistry program, and as a visiting professor at the Balseiro Institute.<ref name=coloquio/><ref name=aporte>{{Cite web |url=https://www.conicet.gov.ar/distinguen-a-la-dra-adriana-serquis-por-su-aporte-al-uso-racional-de-la-energia-electrica/ |title=Distinguen a la Dra. Adriana Serquis por su aporte al uso racional de la energía eléctrica |trans-title=Dr. Adriana Serquis is Recognized for Her Contribution to the Rational Use of Electrical Energy |publisher=[[National Scientific and Technical Research Council|CONICET]] |language=Spanish |date=2014-11-17 |access-date=2021-08-10}}</ref>

She is president of the Argentine Crystallography Association and a member of the administrative council of the {{ill|Argentine Nanotechnology Foundation|es|Fundación Argentina de Nanotecnología}}.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.cristalografia.com.ar/index.php/autoridades |title=Autoridades |publisher=Argentine Crystallography Association |language=Spanish |access-date=2021-08-10}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.fan.org.ar/nosotros/ |title=Consejo de administración |trans-title=Administrative Council |publisher=Argentine Nanotechnology Foundation |language=Spanish |access-date=2021-08-10}}</ref>

She was named president of the CNEA on 4 June 2021.<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://www.telam.com.ar/notas/202106/556668-designacion-comision-nacional-energia-atomica-adriana-serquis.html |archivedate=2 March 2024 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240302173511/https://www.telam.com.ar/notas/202106/556668-designacion-comision-nacional-energia-atomica-adriana-serquis.html |title=Adriana Serquis es la nueva presidenta de la Comisión Nacional de Energía Atómica |trans-title=Adriana Serquis is the New President of the National Atomic Energy Commission |agency=[[Télam]] |language=Spanish |date=2021-06-05 |access-date=2021-08-10 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Awards==
* 2006: [[Bernardo Houssay Award|Bernardo Houssay Young Researcher Award]]<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://www.pagina12.com.ar/diario/ciencia/19-95351-2007-11-28.html |title=Platos que fueron bien lavados |trans-title=Plates That Were Well Cleaned |newspaper=[[Página/12]] |language=Spanish |date=2007-11-28 |access-date=2021-08-10}}</ref>
* 2013: [[Konex Award|Merit Diploma]] in Nanotechnology from the [[Konex Foundation]]<ref name=Konex/>
* 2014: [[L'Oréal-UNESCO For Women in Science Awards|L'Oréal-UNESCO National Award For Women in Science]]<ref name=ganadora/><ref name=aporte/><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.loreal.com.ar/media/novedades/loreal-argentina-entrego-el-premio-nacional-loreal-unesco-por-las-mujeres-en-la-ciencia-2014-5784.htm |title=L'Oréal Argentina entregó el Premio Nacional L'Oréal-Unesco Por las Mujeres en la Ciencia 2014 |trans-title=L'Oréal Argentina Presents the 2014 L'Oréal-UNESCO National Award For Women in Science |publisher=[[L'Oréal]] Argentina |language=Spanish |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180317232726/http://www.loreal.com.ar/media/novedades/loreal-argentina-entrego-el-premio-nacional-loreal-unesco-por-las-mujeres-en-la-ciencia-2014-5784.htm |archive-date=2018-03-17 |url-status=dead |access-date=2021-08-10}}</ref>

==Selected publications==
* "Effect of lattice strain and defects on the superconductivity of MgB2", A Serquis, YT Zhu, EJ Peterson, JY Coulter, DE Peterson, FM Mueller, ''Applied Physics Letters'' 79 (2001), 4399–4401.
* "Strongly enhanced current densities in superconducting coated conductors of YBa2Cu3O7–δ+ BaZrO3", JL MacManus-Driscoll, SR Foltyn, QX Jia, H Wang, A Serquis, L Civale, ''Nature Materials'' 3 (2004), 439–443.
* "High performance nanostructured IT-SOFC cathodes prepared by novel chemical method", L. Baqué, A. Caneiro, M. S. Moreno, A. Serquis, ''Electroch. Comm.'' 10 (2008) 1905.
* "Vertically aligned nanocomposite thin films as a cathode-electrolyte interface layer for thin film solid oxide fuel cells", S.M. Cho, J.S. Yoon, J.H. Kim, Z.X. Bi, A. Serquis, X.H. Zhang, A. Manthiram, and H.Y. Wang, ''Advanced Functional Materials'' 19 (2009) 3868–3873.
* "Synthesis and structural characterization of Co-doped lanthanum strontium titanates", F. Napolitano, D. G. Lamas, A. Soldati, A. Serquis, ''IJHE'' 37 (2012) 18302–18309.
